relations.text: AutodeskとAdobeは、NVIDIA、Pixar、Appleとともに、OpenUSDのためのアライアンスを発足させた
relations.text_en: Autodesk and Adobe, with NVIDIA, Pixar and Apple, announced the Alliance for OpenUSD

source.label: NVIDIA の発表
source.quote: Pixar, Adobe, Apple, Autodesk, and NVIDIA Form Alliance for OpenUSD to Drive Open Standards for 3D Content
source.note: 競合でもあります。2023年の発表で、時期は古いです。
source.note_en: Also a competitor. Announced in 2023; older.

relations.text: 2026年6月、AutodeskはAmazon Web Servicesと戦略的協業契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In June 2026, Autodesk signed a strategic collaboration agreement with Amazon Web Services

source.label: Autodesk の発表
source.quote: Autodesk, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADSK), a global leader in design and make technology, today announced it has signed a strategic collaboration agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS).

relations.text: AutodeskとNVIDIAは、Pixar、Adobe、Appleとともに、OpenUSDのためのアライアンスを発足させた
relations.text_en: Autodesk and NVIDIA, with Pixar, Adobe and Apple, announced the Alliance for OpenUSD

source.label: NVIDIA の発表
source.quote: Pixar, Adobe, Apple, Autodesk, and NVIDIA Form Alliance for OpenUSD to Drive Open Standards for 3D Content
source.note: 2023年の発表で、時期は古いです。

relations.text: NVIDIA Omniverseにより、Autodeskの顧客は自社の技術を他社ツールと併用できると、Autodeskが述べている
relations.text_en: Autodesk says NVIDIA Omniverse lets its customers use Autodesk technology alongside partners' and non-Autodesk tools

source.label: Autodesk ニュースルーム
source.quote: Continuing Autodesk’s emphasis on openness, NVIDIA Omniverse enables our customers to use our technology alongside our partners’ and non-Autodesk tools as needed to customize their workflows.
source.note: 2020年の発表で、時期は古いです。

relations.text: NVIDIAが、Autodeskを含むソフト提供各社が、同社のCloudXR連携でApple Vision Pro向けのアプリを提供していると説明している
relations.text_en: NVIDIA says software providers including Autodesk are using its CloudXR integration to deliver applications to Apple Vision Pro

source.label: NVIDIA ブログ
source.quote: Leading software providers — including Autodesk , Innoactive , Synopsys , Trifork , X-Plane and iRacing — are using the integration to deliver high-fidelity applications natively to Apple Vision Pro.

relations.text: NVIDIAは、Omniverseが接続する業界有力アプリの提供元としてAutodeskを挙げている
relations.text_en: NVIDIA names Autodesk among software companies whose applications connect to its Omniverse ecosystem

source.label: NVIDIA の発表
source.quote: The NVIDIA Omniverse ecosystem continues to grow, connecting industry-leading applications from software companies such as Bentley Systems, Adobe, Autodesk, Epic Games, ESRI, Graphisoft, Trimble, McNeel & Associates, Blender, Marvelous Designer, Reallusion and wrnch Inc.
source.note: 2021年の発表で、時期は古いです。

relations.text: NVIDIAは、Pixar、Adobe、Autodesk、Siemensなどと協力し、USDの機能を拡張する複数年のロードマップを進める
relations.text_en: NVIDIA will pursue a multi-year roadmap to expand USD capabilities together with Pixar, Adobe, Autodesk, Siemens and others

source.label: NVIDIA の発表
source.quote: Working together with USD’s inventor, Pixar, as well as Adobe, Autodesk, Siemens and a host of other leading companies, NVIDIA will pursue a multi-year roadmap to expand USD’s capabilities beyond visual effects
source.note: 2022年の発表で、時期は古いです。

relations.text: AutodeskとAppleは、NVIDIA、Pixar、Adobeとともに、OpenUSDのためのアライアンスを発足させた

source.quote: Pixar, Adobe, Apple, Autodesk, and NVIDIA Form Alliance for OpenUSD to Drive Open Standards for 3D Content
source.note: 2023年の発表で、時期は古いです。

relations.text: AutodeskとSiemensは、製品開発ソフトの非互換によるコストを減らすため、相互運用性に関する合意を発表した
relations.text_en: Autodesk and Siemens announced an interoperability agreement to help manufacturers decrease the costs of incompatibility among product development software

source.label: Autodesk の発表
source.quote: Autodesk, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADSK) and Siemens today announced an interoperability agreement aimed at helping manufacturers decrease the costs associated with incompatibility among product development software applications and avoid potential data integrity problems.
source.note: 2016年の発表で、時期は古いです。
